verdict: WDS crashes under PXE load on a DP. Redundant DHCP relay (IP helper) on backup routers is forwarding duplicate PXE broadcasts, overwhelming the WDS single-threaded handler.
fix: Either disable PXE IP helpers on the backup router (retain them only on primary) OR set the MECM WDS provider to single-threaded: `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SMS\DP SingleThreaded=1` (DWORD) and restart WDS. Single-threaded mode trades throughput for stability; large sites should fix the network instead. Inspect router configs for IP helper redundancy before rolling out PXE at scale.
